anomalies.description: A man in a dark suit is struck violently in the face/neck area by another man, causing his head to snap back and body to recoil; this is followed by rapid motion indicating a physical struggle or takedown inside the elevator.

A violent physical struggle occurs inside an elevator, with multiple men in suits grappling and falling; motion blur and overhead shots (f2, f4, f5) show dynamic combat involving at least three individuals.

After being knocked down, one man remains on the floor while another continues to strike or压制 him (f8–f9, f11, f13–f15); overhead shots (f10, f12, f16) show multiple individuals restraining or assaulting the prone man, indicating a helpless victim being attacked.; After the initial fight, one man is subdued on the floor while another stands over him, appearing to strike or压制 him; frames f6–f7 show a dominant figure looming over a prone victim, consistent with abuse of a helpless person.

A second wave of combat is visible from above (f7–f9), where multiple figures are entangled on the elevator floor, kicking and struggling—indicating ongoing mutual physical combat among several participants.

A man in a dark suit is seen subduing and holding down another man on the floor of an elevator; the victim appears unconscious or incapacitated with visible facial injury (blood near eye), indicating a one-sided attack on a helpless person.
The man in the dark suit is shown holding a handgun with both hands, aiming it forward as he exits the elevator; the weapon is clearly visible and held in a ready-to-fire posture.
